This page lists what adempR 0.1.0 does, how sure we are that it works, and
what it does not do. The statuses mean:

* **verified**: implemented and checked by an automated test against an
  independent calculation (hand calculation, closed form, another
  package, or a bit for bit comparison). Test files are in
  `tests/testthat/`.
* **implemented**: available and exercised in examples, but without a
  test that checks its numerical result independently.
* **experimental**: available, but its interface or behavior may change,
  or it has only been checked in limited settings.
* **deferred**: not available in this version. The architecture leaves
  room for it.

Tests run on GitHub Actions on Linux, macOS and Windows with the current
and previous R releases. Tests that kill R processes are skipped on
Windows. Nothing has been run on a real cluster scheduler or a GPU.

## Study specification

| Capability | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Factorial scenarios with content keys, independent of order | verified | test-design.R, test-rng.R |
| Exclusion and invalid configuration constraints | verified | test-design.R |
| Nested (bound) and sampled designs, scenario weights | verified | test-design.R |
| Estimand metadata and method declarations, with validation of mismatches | verified | test-estimands.R |
| Exact truth | verified | test-normal-mean.R |
| Monte Carlo truth with standard error, cached, carried into MCSE | verified | test-estimands.R |
| Data set specific truth hidden from non-oracle methods | verified | test-estimands.R |
| Unknown truth (truth based measures unavailable) | verified | test-estimands.R |
| Numerical (quadrature) truth with stated error | implemented | used in examples only |
| Public scenario views and oracle methods | verified | test-isolation.R |
| Validation and smoke test | verified | test-design.R |
| Protocol completeness checklist, freezing, amendments | verified | test-design.R |
| Vector and functional estimands | deferred | only scalar estimands; use several scalars |

| Capability | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Stream registry keyed by stage, scenario and component; append only | verified | test-rng.R |
| Invariance to scenario order, method order and chunk size | verified | test-rng.R |
| Extending replications and adding methods leave existing results unchanged | verified | test-rng.R |
| Caller's RNG kind and state restored | verified | test-rng.R |
| `future` backend identical to sequential | verified locally with multisession, two workers | test-rng.R |
| Data isolation between methods, including `data.table` | verified | test-isolation.R |
| Atomic commits; crash at each commit stage and resume | verified on Linux and macOS | test-recovery.R (SIGKILL in a child process) |
| Stale lock recovery on the same host | verified | test-recovery.R |
| Corrupt file detection, quarantine and rerun | verified | test-recovery.R |
| Duplicate deduplication and conflict detection | verified | test-recovery.R |
| Selective invalidation (method refit, truth and measure re-evaluation, DGP refusal) | verified | test-replay-invalidation.R |
| Replay of one replication with data check | verified | test-replay-invalidation.R |
| Retention policies and capability report | verified | test-replay-invalidation.R |
| Cluster schedulers (batchtools, targets) | experimental | possible through `future` plans; not tested |
| Out of core result storage | deferred | results are read into memory; mergeable accumulators are available |

## Performance claims

adempR makes no claim about speed in this version. The overhead per task
(stream lookup, isolation copy, attempt capture) is small compared with
fitting a model, but it has not been benchmarked on an idle machine;
benchmark scripts are planned for a later release.

## Known limitations

* Methods that set their own seeds or use a random number generator other
  than R's break the stream guarantees; replay then reports
  `matches = FALSE`.
* Function fingerprints use deparsed code and the values of referenced
  free variables. Objects reached through other routes (for example a
  global option, or a file read at run time) must be declared in `depends`.
* A lock held by a process on another host, or any stale lock on Windows,
  cannot be checked and must be released with `sim_unlock()`.
* Export bundles contain R code; their checksums detect corruption, not
  tampering.
